# `lakana profile`

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the Typer app. Do not edit by hand:
run `uv run python scripts/generate_reference.py` and commit the result. -->

Part of the [Command line reference](../cli.md), which lists the options for every command.

Usage: `lakana profile [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Manage saved profiles (local only).

## `lakana profile list`

Usage: `lakana profile list [OPTIONS]`

List saved profiles; tokens are never shown.

## `lakana profile use`

Usage: `lakana profile use [OPTIONS] {name}`

Make NAME the default profile.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | text | required |  |
| `--env` | text | none | Also set its default environment. |

## `lakana profile remove`

Usage: `lakana profile remove [OPTIONS] {name}`

Delete profile NAME and its token.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | text | required |  |
| `--yes` | flag | off | Don't ask for confirmation. |
